srList.sentence: Inclusion criteria were original report of a single RCT in a population with RA, parallel design, drug therapy intervention and a clinical primary endpoint.

srList.sentence: Funding source, experimental agent used, study phase, study duration, study outcome, sample size calculation, participant flow description, overall subject dropout, self-reported data analysis method, actual data analysis method used (determined by study reviewers), missing data proportion and missing data handling methods were assessed.

srList.sentence: Comparison of RCT characteristics among trials using different analysis approaches and temporal changes from 2006 to 2016 was assessed using Pearsons Kh2 tests, Fishers exact test or likelihood ratio tests (for categorical variables) and Mann-Whitney U tests or Kruskal-Wallis tests (for continuous variables).
